title: BYODA calibration =》red triangle in AAPS
symptom: After calibrating in BYODA, AAPS shows a red triangle and the displayed BG value differs from xDrip and BYODA for a few minutes before aligning. The issue occurs intermittently, often when calibrating shortly after a sensor reading.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak states it is impossible to detect from the received batch (only 1 wrong value) and suggests comparing with database would be expensive.
evidence_quote: this is impossible to detect from received batch (only 1 wrong value). The only way would be compare with database which would be expensive
